Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the target CHEMBL2179. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, and join assays to target_dictionary on tid. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL2179. Require structures via an inner join to compound_structures. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
